What

What Seasoned Firewood Delivery Involves

Seasoned firewood delivery means locally sourced hardwood — split from Roubic's own NE Ohio tree work — that has been stacked and air-dried on the Auburn Township yard for 6–12 months until moisture drops below 20%. Below that threshold, wood lights cleanly, burns hot with high BTU output, and produces minimal creosote, so it's safe for indoor wood stoves and fireplaces. Green wood above 20% smolders, builds creosote, and raises chimney-fire risk.

Every load is moisture-tested under 20% before it leaves the yard and delivered by face cord, half cord, or full cord. Because our wood comes from our own tree work, it stays within the local emerald ash borer (EAB) quarantine zone. Stacked placement at your property is available for an additional fee.

Common Firewood Questions

Seasoned Firewood FAQ

Five things NE Ohio homeowners want to know before ordering.

How long is the firewood seasoned at Roubic?
6–12 months on the Auburn Township yard, stacked with airflow on all sides. Ash and maple season faster (often 6–8 months); oak takes longer (10–12 months). Every load is moisture-tested under 20% before delivery.
How much does seasoned firewood cost in NE Ohio?
Pricing is sensitive to delivery distance and cord size, so we quote each order before it goes out. Call {{global.phone}} for current per-cord pricing. Stacked delivery is available for an additional fee, and bulk or recurring orders qualify for a discount.
What species is the firewood?
Mixed hardwood — predominantly oak, maple, ash, beech, and elm — all locally sourced from Roubic's own NE Ohio tree work. Because it comes from our own jobs, the wood stays within the local emerald ash borer (EAB) quarantine zone.
Can I burn seasoned firewood in my indoor wood stove?
Yes — properly seasoned firewood under 20% moisture is safe for indoor wood stoves and fireplaces. Green wood above 20% is not: it smolders, builds creosote, and raises chimney-fire risk. Roubic's wood is moisture-tested under 20% before delivery.
Do you deliver and stack the firewood?
Yes. We deliver by face cord, half cord, or full cord on a schedule set by your service tier, with priority scheduling in Tier 1 markets. Loads can be dumped where you want them, or neatly stacked at your property for an additional fee.
